label: PF Backlog 579
title: Defect/RCCA: backlog.update() did not sync epic.children[] on epic/parent change -> chronic backlog residue that fails the residue gate on every branch (fixed; delivered with A4)
body: 5-Why: (1) branches failed test_real_backlog_has_no_residue with 'epic children[] out of sync'; (2) an epic's children[] listed fewer ids than items actually carrying that epic; (3) membership was set/changed via core.backlog.update(), which did NOT keep children[] in sync -- only add_epic did; (4) _sync_epic_children calls update() so it could not be called from inside update()'s lock without self-locking, so the writer left the gap; (5) no guard ensured epic.children == actual children on every membership write, so drift accumulated as items were added/re-homed (concurrent sessions). Guard/fix: backlog.update() now syncs children[] for the old+new epic/parent AFTER releasing the lock; delivered on the A4 branch (BI-PF-0397, PR #76) which also resynced the drifted epics.
